units.source_text: 这是前文所谓本末不称的劣诗。

en.t: This is the poor poem mentioned earlier, whose beginning and end do not match.

units.source_text: 因为小草与海无缘，伊香加崎在近江国，田子浦在骏河国，皆与常陆海无缘。

en.t: This is because the little grass has no connection with the sea; Ikagasaki is in Omi Province, and Tago Bay is in Suruga Province, so neither has any connection with the sea of Hitachi.
The little grass is a comparison for herself.

units.source_text: 她用“伊香加崎”，因为此地名在日文中发音与“安得”相同。

en.t: She uses “Ikagasaki” because the Japanese pronunciation of this place name is the same as “how could I.”

units.source_text: “田子”比拟她自己是在田舍长大起来的女子。

en.t: “Tago” compares her to a woman who grew up in the countryside.

units.source_text: 全诗大意：“我是田舍人家的女子，却希望会见女御。”

en.t: The general meaning of the whole poem is: “I am a girl from a country household, yet I hope to meet the Lady Consort.”
